@FramedCodec.decode_encode : ∀ {α : Type} (codec : FramedCodec α) (value : α),
  codec.decode (codec.encode value) = some value
decodeNat_encodeNat_append : ∀ (n : ℕ) (suffix : List UInt8), decodeNat (encodeNat n ++ suffix) = some (n, suffix)
ext4Codec : LawfulCodec E
rootCodec : LawfulCodec Digest
pathCodec : LawfulCodec (List Digest)
receiptCodec : (m queryCount : ℕ) → LawfulCodec (Receipt m queryCount)
encodeRate_extBlock : ∀ (value : E),
  encodeRate (extBlock value) = ext4Framed.encode value ++ encodeFields (List.ofFn fun x => 0)
ext4_decode_eq_rateChallenge : ∀ (value : E),
  ext4Framed.decode (ext4Framed.encode value) = some (rateChallenge (extBlock value))
digestFramed_decode_eq_decodeRate : ∀ (bytes : List UInt8), digestFramed.decode bytes = decodeRate bytes
@merkle_path_bytes_verify_iff : ∀ {k : ℕ} (root : Digest) (index : Fin (2 ^ k)) (value : E) (path : List Digest),
  (∃ decoded,
      pathFramed.decode (pathFramed.encode path) = some decoded ∧
        (BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite k).verifyOpen root index value decoded) ↔
    (BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite k).verifyOpen root index value path
@merkle_path_extra_sibling_refused : ∀ {k : ℕ} (root : Digest) (index : Fin (2 ^ k)) (value : E) (path : List Digest)
  (sibling : Digest),
  path.length = k → ¬(BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite k).verifyOpen root index value (path ++ [sibling])
@bcs_accept_bytes_iff : ∀ {ell m queryCount : ℕ} (T : FoldingTower E (PowerTwoFriLevels ell) m)
  (st : RawFriAdaptiveTranscript fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) (hmell : m ≤ ell)
  (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount),
  AcceptsBytes T st hmell statement queryCount ((receiptFramed m queryCount).encode receipt) ↔
    Accepts T st hmell statement receipt
@acceptsBytes_trailing_refused : ∀ {ell m queryCount : ℕ} (T : FoldingTower E (PowerTwoFriLevels ell) m)
  (st : RawFriAdaptiveTranscript fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) (hmell : m ≤ ell)
  (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (suffix : List UInt8),
  suffix ≠ [] → ¬AcceptsBytes T st hmell statement queryCount ((receiptFramed m queryCount).encode receipt ++ suffix)
@acceptsBytes_terminalRoot_tamper_refused : ∀ {ell m queryCount : ℕ} (T : FoldingTower E (PowerTwoFriLevels ell) m)
  (st : RawFriAdaptiveTranscript fun n => BinaryMerkle.openingScheme hashSuite (ell - n)) (hmell : m ≤ ell)
  (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (root : Digest),
  root ≠ receipt.terminalRoot →
    Accepts T st hmell statement receipt →
      ¬AcceptsBytes T st hmell statement queryCount
          ((receiptFramed m queryCount).encode (tamperTerminalRoot receipt root))
